verses.pali: Atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinnaṁ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṁ gahapatiṁ bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: Then the householder Anāthapiṇḍika went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side. The Buddha said to him:

verses.pali: “Bhojanaṁ, gahapati, dadamāno ariyasāvako paṭiggāhakānaṁ cattāri ṭhānāni deti.
verses.english: “Householder, when a noble disciple gives food, they give the recipients four things.

verses.pali: Āyuṁ deti, vaṇṇaṁ deti, sukhaṁ deti, balaṁ deti.
verses.english: Long life, beauty, happiness, and strength.

verses.pali: Āyuṁ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
verses.english: Giving long life, they have long life as a god or human. …

verses.pali: Vaṇṇaṁ datvā … sukhaṁ datvā … balaṁ datvā balassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
Bhojanaṁ, gahapati, dadamāno ariyasāvako paṭiggāhakānaṁ imāni cattāri ṭhānāni detīti.
verses.english: When a noble disciple gives food, they give the recipients these four things.
Carefully giving food at the right time,
to those who are disciplined, <j>eating only what others give,
you provide them with four things:
long life, beauty, happiness, and strength.
